05 / GOOD QUESTIONSLET’S CLEAR THINGS UP

BEFORE
YOU JUMP IN.

No overthinking required.
Just a little preparation.

Do I need to be an expert coder?+

No. The opening round covers HTML, CSS, basic programming and reasoning. Creativity, communication and teamwork matter throughout the event. Freshers are welcome.

Can students from different years team up?+

Yes. The event is open to first, second and third-year students. Mixed-year teams are welcome; having a particular mix of years is not mandatory.

How many people can be in a team?+

Check the official MakeMyPass registration page for the current team-size requirements. Start finding teammates with complementary strengths.

Is there a registration fee?+

The registration fee is ₹20. Complete your registration and payment through MakeMyPass.

What should we bring?+

Bring your college ID, a notebook, and your enthusiasm. Device requirements and any round-specific instructions will be shared by the organisers before the event.

What can we win?+

First place: ₹3,000 · Second place: ₹1,500 · Third place: ₹500. Participation certificates for all.
